reviews.name: Greg P.
reviews.text:
Wow what a time we had. Let me start with Brian, poor guy, This had to be his longest estimate in his career, Unfortunately for Brian I am that pain in the you know what guy. We discussed underlayment's and how they are applied, we discussed all roofing options, fascia board repair, and eave repair. Brians Knowledge is what I needed to  help make my decision for  what would be the best fit for my 1920s home.
The tear down was done cleanly and efficiently, By efficiently, I mean there was a chance of rain. The team made sure we where always dried in. No leeks during the project. Cleanup every night, and of course more questions from you know who.
(The Crew) Shawn has put together is quite the crew, Again everybody friendly, knowledgeable and willing to take the time to explain why, what, where and how, to you know who.

I believe the first few days were smoking hot, attitudes where high, everybody  working together like a well oiled machine and get this they were having fun, The comradery between the team was great, hell I wanted to join the fun.
Point being, If you're having fun and enjoy the work you do the outcome is Quality. Oh by the way the rain came down Hard they stayed up on that roof and made sure we would be good and dry for the night. They were  all sopping wet and still good attitudes, joking around no big deal.
I have worked with many contractors in my time but have not had the experience I have had with French Roofing. Lets just say, French Roofing will be handling all my roof projects and will be the only recommendation I will be giving out.

Thanks for the outstanding job and education.

reply.text:
Greg, thank you so much for the kind words! I really appreciate you taking the time to write such a thoughtful review—and I’ll definitely be sharing this with the whole crew.

This line of work isn’t easy—long days, hard labor, and whatever Mother Nature decides to throw at us—but hearing feedback like this makes it all worth it. Over the years, I’ve learned that I can train for skill and teach the technical side of roofing, but attitude is everything. That’s what I hire for, and it means a lot to see that shine through in your experience.

Brian might still be recovering from that epic estimate 😅 but he really enjoyed working with you—and let’s be honest, not everyone brings that level of curiosity and care to the table. You were thoughtful, engaged, and clearly wanted to do right by your home. That kind of partnership makes a difference.

And I couldn’t be prouder of the crew. They’re not just great roofers—they’re solid guys who take pride in their work and have fun doing it. Rain or shine (or heatwave!), they show up with good attitudes and a team-first mindset.

We’re honored to be your go-to for roofing projects moving forward. Seriously, thank you again for trusting us—and for making this job a fun one.

– Sean
Owner, French Roofing
